lead: A short hint shown on hover or focus. Its behaviour (delay, positioning, collision flipping, keyboard) comes from Base UI's Tooltip.

styling.title: Styling Reference
styling.description: Theme styles handle it in `tooltip.css`; the colors come from `--ui-tooltip-bg` / `--ui-tooltip-fg`.
styling.positioner: The positioner; theme styles set its z-index here
styling.popup: The bubble itself: background, padding, radius, max width
styling.arrow: The arrow; `data-side` decides which edge it sits on
styling.states: Starting styles for entering / leaving; theme styles use them for a fade + scale
